hero.title: 7 Best Rooftop Bars in Phnom Penh
hero.dek: Uncover Phnom Penh's best high-altitude haunts with our Reddit-backed guide to the 7 must-visit rooftop bars for epic views and vibes.

intro.answerFirst: Phnom Penh's rooftop bars range from $5 to $20+ per cocktail, with Sora Sky Bar being a top recommendation for its luxury and Japanese whiskey selection. These elevated bars provide unique atmospheres and stunning views, making them a must-visit in the Cambodian capital.
body: Phnom Penh's rooftop bar scene has exploded in recent years. The Cambodian capital — perched at the junction of the Mekong and Tonlé Sap rivers — now boasts a skyline dotted with sky bars, revolving lounges, and open-air terraces that rival anything in Bangkok or Singapore.

We dug through dozens of Reddit threads from r/cambodia, r/solotravel, and expat forums to find the rooftop bars that actual residents and seasoned travelers keep recommending. From the 37th-floor luxury of Sora to the bohemian charm of Sundown Social Club above the Russian Market — these are the elevated spots worth your evening.
intro.methodology: We analyzed 50+ Reddit posts and 300+ comments across r/cambodia, r/solotravel, and Phnom Penh expat communities — spanning 2023 to 2026. Bars were ranked by how frequently they were recommended by independent users. We cross-referenced with rooftop bar guides and traveler blogs to verify each venue is still open and operating. Priority was given to long-term Phnom Penh residents' picks over first-time visitor posts.

faq.question: What is the best rooftop bar in Phnom Penh?
faq.answer: Based on Reddit consensus, Sora Sky Bar at the Rosewood (37th floor of Vattanac Capital) is the most acclaimed rooftop bar in Phnom Penh. It offers the most luxurious experience with a cantilevered terrace, Japanese whiskey selection, and panoramic city views. For a unique experience, Celeste Revolving Sky Bar on the 43rd floor is the world's first revolving sky bar.

faq.question: How much do drinks cost at Phnom Penh rooftop bars?
faq.answer: Prices vary widely. Budget-friendly spots like Sundown Social Club offer cocktails from $5–$8 USD. Mid-range bars like Eclipse Sky Bar and Le Moon charge $7–$12 for cocktails. Premium venues like Sora Sky Bar and Celeste range from $12–$20+ per cocktail. Draft beer is typically $3–$6 everywhere. Happy hour deals (usually 5–7 PM) can save you 30–50% at many venues.

faq.question: What is the dress code for Phnom Penh rooftop bars?
faq.answer: Most Phnom Penh rooftop bars enforce smart casual dress codes. Avoid flip-flops, tank tops, and beachwear at upscale venues like Sora, Celeste, and HighGround. Closed shoes and collared shirts are recommended for these spots. More relaxed venues like Sundown Social Club and Le Moon are casual-friendly — shorts and sandals are fine.

faq.question: What is the best time to visit rooftop bars in Phnom Penh?
faq.answer: Sunset — typically between 5:30 PM and 6:30 PM — is the golden hour for Phnom Penh rooftop bars. Arrive 30 minutes early to secure a good spot, especially on weekends. The dry season (November to April) offers the best weather with clear skies and comfortable temperatures. During rainy season (May to October), check if venues have covered areas.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for rooftop bars in Phnom Penh?
faq.answer: For premium venues like Sora Sky Bar and Celeste, reservations are highly recommended, especially for weekend evenings and sunset tables. Most mid-range bars operate on a first-come, first-served basis. Le Moon recommends booking if you want a riverside-view table. Casual spots like Sundown Social Club rarely need reservations.
